changelog:
- Weapons now visually kick back when firing while aiming down sights, then ease back smoothly. Feel varies per weapon. Found under Weapons > Recoil > Per-Weapon Recoil Options > Extra Options > ADS Recoil. Enabled by default.
- Fixed a bug that caused a crash when using the Car Crash Inertia mod.
- Added Use Separate Vehicle FOV. You can now set separate FOV values for On Foot and In Vehicle. Found under General > Camera > FOV. Disabled by default.
- Added FOV FX: a smooth lerp toward your configured FOV values when entering first person. Found under General > Switches. Enabled by default.
- Fixed a bug that caused you to keep walking when aiming a weapon.
- You can now edit your configuration file, import new weapon configurations, and more using share/config-editor.html.
